Your earlier answer fits 4 different ideas. This question gives different answers for different ideas:

If the mix-up were sensor versus instruction, you would expect Only the “otherwise” part (move).
If the mix-up were comparison direction, you would expect Only the “if” part (turn).
If the mix-up were running both branches, you would expect “Both parts”.
If the mix-up were skipping the “otherwise” part, you would expect “Neither part”.
Someone who understands it would expect Only the “otherwise” part (move).

Whatever you pick, it’s evidence, not a grade.
